name: TIR_OPERATOR
description: Blast field operator. Can enter blast_charge events and scan detonator serials (D3-21). Site-scoped via Keycloak group. Requires PERMIS_EXPLOSIFS habilitation checked via RhHabilitationService.isValidAt at blast loading time.

name: TIR_SUPERVISOR
description: Blast supervisor. Can create and request-fire blast_plan, validate HSE clearance (D3-22). Composite: includes TIR_OPERATOR privileges. Site-scoped.

name: HR_MANAGER
description: HR manager. Full CRUD on employees, certifications, shift rosters (RH-01, RH-02, RH-03, RH-04). Tenant-scoped (not site-scoped — can see all sites within the tenant).

name: SHIFT_SUPERVISOR
description: Shift supervisor. Can record shift_entry for their site only (RH-02). Site-scoped via Keycloak group.

name: PROCESSING_OPERATOR
description: Processing operator. Can open and close crusher_session and screening_session (CON-01, CRI-01). Site-scoped.

name: SALES_MANAGER
description: Sales manager. Full CRUD on customers, contracts; can generate invoices and bon de livraison (VTE-01, VTE-02). Tenant-scoped.

name: FINANCE_OFFICER
description: Finance officer. Can enter FX rates and trigger invoice batch processing (VTE-03, FIN-01). Tenant-scoped.

name: MAINTENANCE_TECH
description: Maintenance technician. Can open/close work_orders, record spare part consumption (MNT-01, MNT-02). Site-scoped. Requires FORMATION_HSE habilitation for hazardous equipment.
